ctx.x: Yes, because Irene and Teddy were staying at Benny's house -- they were staying with Benny. Benny had brought them out and they were staying at his house then.
They were, yeah, cause I know they used to come at to Forest Hills quite a bit.

Yeah. Well listen, well we've got to go back from there for a little while. So, really you and Mildred had been going out together, listening to music and everything, for maybe a year and a half or so, by then.
